# 般若心經解義節要

**ID:** X0535
**Volume:** X26
**Category:** 般若部類
**Original Category:** 大小乘釋經部／般若部疏
**Byline:** 明 宋濂文句
**Dynasty:** 明
**Date:** 1368–1644
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/X0535

## Contributors
- 宋濂 (A007271)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle mid-Míng anthology of selected passages from successive masters' commentaries on the *Heart Sūtra* (Xuánzàng's short-recension version, T251 = [KR6c0128](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0128)), compiled by the lay devotee [無念居士](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%84%A1%E5%BF%B5%E5%B1%85%E5%A3%AB) Wúniàn jūshì in Jiājìng 12 (1533). Preserved in the Wàn xùzàng / *Manji zoku-zō* as X535. The catalog attributes authorship to Sòng Lián 宋濂 (1310–1381) because his *wénjù* 文句 (line-by-line text gloss) is the latest substantive scholarly contribution incorporated; the actual compiler is the otherwise-unknown lay devotee Wúniàn jūshì, working in 1533.

The compiler's bibliographic preface (No. 535-A) lists the cited authorities:

- [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98) *Xuánzàng* (Tang) — translator of the parent sūtra
- [法藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E8%97%8F) *Fǎzàng* (Tang) — *Lüèshū* T1712 ([KR6c0139](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0139))
- *Zhīyuán* 知圓 [= Gūshān [智圓](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E5%9C%93) Zhìyuán] (Sòng) — *shū* X529 ([KR6c0148](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0148)). **Note**: the listing reads 知圓, but this is a transcription error for 智圓; the same Northern-Sòng Tiāntái master at Gūshān is meant.
- *Yuán* [古雲](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%8F%A4%E9%9B%B2) *Gǔyún* (Yuán) — *zhù* (otherwise lost)
- *Yuán* [佛海性證](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BD%9B%E6%B5%B7%E6%80%A7%E8%AD%89) *Fóhǎi Xìngzhèng* (Yuán) — *zhù* (otherwise lost)
- [宗泐](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%97%E6%B3%90) *Zōnglè* (Míng) — the imperial *zhùjiě* T1714 ([KR6c0141](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0141)), composed under Hóngwǔ
- [宋濂](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%AE%8B%E6%BF%82) *Sòng Lián* (Míng), styled "Hànlín Academician of Qiánxī" — his independent *wénjù* on the Heart Sūtra

The compilation thus presents a Yuán–Míng–era cross-section of Heart Sūtra exegesis from the Tang to Sòng Lián's day, extracting what the compiler considers the most acute passages from each.

**Abstract**

X535 is a primary witness to mid-Míng *jūshì* (lay-devotee) Buddhist study culture and to the curated reception of Tang–Sòng commentaries by Míng readers. Its scholarly importance lies in: (i) preserving substantial fragments of two otherwise-lost Yuán commentaries (Gǔyún's and Fóhǎi Xìngzhèng's *zhù*); (ii) preserving Sòng Lián's *wénjù*, the only surviving substantial Buddhist exegetical writing by this most prominent of Hóngwǔ-era literati; and (iii) documenting the Míng *jūshì* reading culture in which Heart Sūtra study was conducted through the cross-temporal cento-anthology rather than through the production of new full-scale commentaries.

The Sòng Lián *wénjù* incorporated here is one of two substantial Heart Sūtra contributions known from this author (the other is his preface to the Hóngwǔ-era state-Buddhist canon). Sòng Lián's prose style — measured, classically allusive, drawing on both Confucian and Buddhist citations — gives the compilation its distinctive late-Yuán / early-Míng literatus flavour.

Composition date: the compiler's preface is dated 1533 (Jiājìng 12). The constituent materials predate this — Sòng Lián's *wénjù* belongs to the 1370s (before his death in 1381), Zōnglè's to 1378 (per [KR6c0141](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0141)), Fǎzàng's to c. 700, Gūshān Zhìyuán's to c. 1017. The bracket *notBefore* / *notAfter* both 1533 reflect the compiled-anthology date.

The work circulated in late-Míng *jūshì* circles and entered the *Wàn xùzàng* through Japanese sources.
